title: Vaporesso Moti X Mini Replacement Pod 2ml 2 Pack
description: The new X Mini pod kit is an exciting collaboration between vape pioneers Vaporesso and Moti. The X Mini is an incredibly compact RDTL (Restricted Direct to Lung) pod device with a stylish open-circuit design, a long-lasting internal 1150mAh battery, intelligent coil recognition and a form factor that fits snugly in the palm of your hand. This replacement 2ml pod enables adjustable airflow by simply rotating the pod in the device. The X Mini pod is compatible with Vaporesso X Moti X35 coils, whose unique honeycomb mesh design delivers an incredible RDTL (Restricted Direct to Lung) vape experience, every time. The coils are best paired with high-VG e-liquids.
